findings.text: Console descriptor holds identity in name with index and flags, line control in cflag with speeds ispeed and ospeed, delivery accounting in seq and dropped, private context in data and list linkage in node, classic driver hooks for write read device unblank setup exit and match, plus optional nonblocking hooks for atomic and threaded output with device level lock control and internal sequencing threading and buffering support.

Atomic output hook may run in any context including nonmaskable paths, relies solely on console ownership for synchronization without locking, must bracket register manipulation with unsafe enter and exit helpers, must abandon immediately when ownership is lost and treat supplied buffer as untrusted, should permit takeover whenever safe to preserve messages, and cannot resume printing after reacquire because buffer access is gone.

Threaded output hook runs only in task context while holding both driver device lock and normal priority ownership, with ownership checks and unsafe section handling matching atomic path for mutual exclusion; device lock serializes kernel message output against driver hardware use via driver native mechanism, always from task context, must prevent migration, and forwards opaque flags value from lock to unlock.

Console list offers sleepable locked iteration requiring held list lock and read side iteration usable under read protection; flag fetch asserts read protection and uses single copy load, while flag store requires held list lock and uses single copy store paired with reader.

Usability requires enabled marker and absence of suspended marker; nonblocking consoles need atomic hook when atomic output is requested and permit unsafe atomic variant only when unsafe takeovers are allowed, otherwise threaded hook serves even without printer threads; legacy consoles need classic write hook; offline processor needs anytime marker to allow use before processor is marked up.

Exposed helpers include read protection test, flag reader and writer, two list iterators for protected and locked traversal, usability predicate covering enabled suspended nonblocking legacy and processor online conditions, flush mode selector, empty sysfs notification, and unlocked usage warning.
Flush control orders CONSOLE_FLUSH_PENDING before CONSOLE_REPLAY_ALL, pending first and full replay second.

Fallback configuration provides no operation emergency handling and buffer attachment, reports inability to proceed, denies kernel debugger and braille acquisition with empty release, reports no braille context, and reports unusable through alternate predicate.

Character cell state combines style toggles italic underline blink and reverse with intensity level, cursor coordinates x and y, base color, and charset selection via Gx_charset tables plus charset flag.
Font descriptor pairs bitmap pointer data with total glyphs charcount and cell geometry width height.

Terminal instance aggregates upper port, two character states, numeric identity, dimension counts, address words for screen memory and visible window, scroll bounds, operation pointer, buffer pointer with size, mode byte, attribute bytes, cursor words and address, font descriptor with mask and erase word, parser words with fixed parameter array, switch structures with process handle and wait queue, packed single bit display flags with multi bit privilege mouse and unicode markers, fixed tab bitmap, fixed palette bytes, translation pointer, bell words, blink word, foreground double pointer, unicode page pointers with line tables, and saved screen pointers with saved dimensions; wrapper holds instance pointer plus work item.

Escape parameter capacity NPAR equals sixteen, tab stop capacity VC_TABSTOPS_COUNT equals two hundred fifty six, intensity enumeration orders VCI_HALF_BRIGHT then VCI_NORMAL then VCI_BOLD with mask VCI_MASK covering low two bits.

Cursor code packs size in low nibble with change in middle byte and set in high byte via CUR_MAKE, extracted by CUR_SIZE plus CUR_CHANGE plus CUR_SET; size selectors encode zero to six stepping CUR_DEF then CUR_NONE then CUR_UNDERLINE then CUR_LOWER_THIRD then CUR_LOWER_HALF then CUR_TWO_THIRDS to CUR_BLOCK; modifiers occupy single bits above size nibble via CUR_SW plus CUR_ALWAYS_BG plus CUR_INVERT_FG_BG with color nibbles CUR_FG plus CUR_BG higher.
Translation selector ascends from zero ordering LAT1_MAP then GRAF_MAP then IBMPC_MAP then USER_MAP, with FIRST_MAP aliasing start and LAST_MAP aliasing end.

Fallback helpers report unit width and zero recompose plus zero fallback, empty init, null table selection, unchanged glyph for inverse query, identity eight bit to unicode, low byte mask unicode to eight bit, and low byte passthrough with negative above byte range for unicode to personal computer path.

Interrupt aggregate UART_IER_ALL_INTR joins modem receive line transmit holding and receive data enables; length helper UART_LCR_WLEN subtracts five; empty test UART_LSR_BOTH_EMPTY requires both holding and shift empty with checker uart_lsr_tx_empty; modem aggregate UART_MSR_STATUS_BITS joins carrier ring data set and clear to send.

Counter blocks record modem transitions plus transmit receive frame parity overrun break and buffer overrun totals, with compact combined form in async_icount and split per signal form in uart_icount.

Platform descriptor pairs address bases iobase and membase and mapbase with size mapsize, timing uartclk and interrupt irq plus irqflags, tuning regshift and iotype and hub6 with sysrq marker has_sysrq and fixed type plus flags plus bugs, private context, and hooks for register access divisor handling termios discipline modem query interrupt power and break processing.

Device identifiers set PLAT8250_DEV_LEGACY at minus one then step PLAT8250_DEV_PLATFORM then PLAT8250_DEV_PLATFORM1 then PLAT8250_DEV_PLATFORM2 then PLAT8250_DEV_FOURPORT then PLAT8250_DEV_ACCENT then PLAT8250_DEV_BOCA then PLAT8250_DEV_EXAR_ST16C554 then PLAT8250_DEV_HUB6 then PLAT8250_DEV_AU1X00 then PLAT8250_DEV_SM501 ascending from zero.

Interrupt bundle in uart_8250_ops provides timer plus release plus setup hooks, while RS485 helper in uart_8250_em485 pairs tx_stopped with port and active_timer plus start_tx_timer and stop_tx_timer.

Runtime port builds on port adding em485 with start and stop hooks plus divisor hooks, dma and ops pointers, overrun backoff work with timeout, console completion and modem gating with work item, saved line and modem flags with masks, gpios handle and probe marker, power activity with canary, cached control bytes with cur_iotype and tx_loadsz, capabilities with bugs, shared list linkage and timer.
Read clear bits must be preserved via MSR_SAVE_FLAGS and LSR_SAVE_FLAGS, probe marker UART_PROBE_RSA uses low bit, console tracks line end state, and modem work queuing can be gated.
Setup helpers rt288x_setup and au_platform_setup report absence while hp300_setup_serial_console reports success.

Operation table provides lifecycle via pm plus type plus request_port plus release_port plus config_port plus verify_port plus ioctl, line control via set_termios plus set_ldisc, activation via shutdown plus startup plus flush_buffer, signaling via get_mctrl plus set_mctrl plus enable_ms plus break_ctl, receiver via start_rx plus stop_rx, transmitter via tx_empty plus start_tx plus stop_tx plus unthrottle plus throttle plus send_xchar, debugging via poll_get_char plus poll_put_char plus poll_init.
Poll absence marker NO_POLL_CHAR equals 0x00ff0000; configuration selectors use low bits with UART_CONFIG_TYPE equal one and UART_CONFIG_IRQ equal two.
Flag type upf_t and status type upstat_t use distinct bitwise integers; I/O selector uart_iotype sets UPIO_UNKNOWN at minus one with UPIO_PORT plus UPIO_HUB6 plus UPIO_MEM mapping to bus codes.

Entering unsafe hardware section without ownership check risks racing a higher priority takeover; assuming buffer remains valid after loss or after reacquire risks using foreign data; calling thread callback without task context or migration disabled risks synchronization failure.

Emitting through driver lacking anytime support on offline processor risks using uninitialized per processor resources; writing without console lock outside oops risks interleaved output flagged by unlocked warning.

Console and serial layers export flag accessors list traversal usability checks, conversion fallbacks, counter blocks, operation tables for generic and 8250 ports, platform descriptors, and setup helpers for driver binding.
